Figures are aggregated, rounded and anonymized. They describe work handled or coordinated, not personal revenue, ownership, an employer disclosure or a commercial commitment.

## Important boundaries

This is a personal professional website, not a manufacturer, regulatory authority, sourcing agency or live product catalogue. Product availability, registration status, specifications and commercial terms require project-specific formal confirmation. Public cockpit screens use fictional companies and fully synthetic demo figures.

## Direct answers

### What does Jed Liu do?

Jed Liu works in pharmaceutical international business. He connects commercial opportunities with customer communication, product discussion, quotation and negotiation, registration coordination, contract and production follow-up, shipment documentation and final delivery.

### Which markets are represented?

Publicly stated experience centers on Latin America and Central Asia/CIS while working from China. Named markets include Colombia, Venezuela, Mexico, Peru, Paraguay, Chile, Honduras and Uzbekistan.

### Which product categories are represented?

Experience includes finished dosage forms—such as sterile injectables, antibiotics and other formulations—and active pharmaceutical ingredients with related technical and quality documentation. These are experience categories, not a live catalogue.

### How are AI and automation used?

AI, automation and purpose-built software support repetitive work around quotations, contract preparation, order visibility and market monitoring. Human relationships, professional judgment and project-specific confirmation remain central.

## 中文摘要

Jed Liu 从事医药国际业务，工作覆盖产品与机会沟通、报价与谈判、注册协调、合同与生产跟进、发运文件和最终交付。区域经验主要集中在拉丁美洲与中亚/CIS。这里展示的是经汇总、取整和脱敏后的个人工作记录，不构成制造商声明、实时产品目录或供应要约。
